purpose: Authorize exactly six bounded, non-scientific repository ergonomics and modularity implementation increments for QntyLab: (C1) a bounded deterministic agent context packet, (C2) modularization of qntylab/project_context.py, (C3) a dev-loop/CI split, (C4) Python tooling normalization, (C5) proven delete-safe slimming, and (C6) repository ergonomics fitness functions. The objective is to reduce the cold-start agent context surface, bound the project-context and CI monoliths, normalize tooling, remove only forensically proven-safe dead weight, and freeze the gains as executable fitness functions — with zero scientific authority, zero frozen-output mutation, and zero open-PR contamination. This is an ergonomics and modularity umbrella only; it grants no research, evaluation, execution, claim, or trading authority of any kind.

CURRENT_STATE_IS_NOT_HISTORY.rule: The live worktree and canonical master HEAD are the only operative state; closed projects, frozen evidence, and cold history are read-only context, never a basis for re-deriving current authority.

SECURITY_BY_SMALL_TRUSTED_CORE.rule: Security-relevant semantics (authority checks, fail-closed gates, hash bindings) stay in a small, auditable trusted core; ergonomics work must shrink, not grow, the surface that must be trusted.

INFORMATION_HIDING.rule: Module boundaries hide implementation detail behind stable interfaces; modularization (C2) must reduce cross-module knowledge, not relocate it.

POINTERS_OVER_COPIES.rule: Context surfaces carry path+line+hash pointers into canonical state, never duplicated copies of state or invariant prose; the packet (C1) points, it does not restate.

COLD_HISTORY.rule: Terminal project records, frozen runs, and historical evidence stay cold: never loaded by default, never rewritten, never migrated to archive/LFS/DVC under this decision.

EXECUTABLE_ARCHITECTURE.rule: Every architectural constraint this decision imposes is enforced by an executable check (fitness functions, C6), not by prose alone.

SMALL_BOUNDED_CHANGES.rule: Each increment is one bounded completion lifecycle with fixed allowed/forbidden surfaces; no unbounded subphase loops, no scope creep, no follow-on increments beyond the six enumerated.
